content: If data is transmitted using an IPv4 UDP socket which is bound to a local address (TcpIpAddrId) of type Multicast, then the TcpIp shall use the IP address of the configured local address (TcpIpAddrId), which is of type IPv4 Unicast and assigned to the same EthIfCtrl, as the bound local address (TcpIpAddrId) as source IP address in the IP datagram header.
